tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background — chalk in light, floodlit night in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs and anything that sits on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, track backgrounds for progress bars, tab rails, skeletons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` (≥15:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, metadata on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` (≥5.9:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers between rows. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons) — 3.4:1 on `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: pitch
tokens.usage: Brand green. Primary buttons, selected states, brand moments, links. Pair text on it with `on-pitch`.

tokens.name: pitch-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed state of `pitch`, hero bands, the darker stripe of the mown-pitch pattern.

tokens.name: pitch-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind selected rows and the brand badge; text on it is `pitch` (light) or `ink` (dark).

tokens.name: on-pitch
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `pitch` and `pitch-deep` fills (10:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: Accent — the highlighter. Personal bests, the active progress fill, one hero CTA per screen. Never body text.

tokens.name: on-volt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `volt` fills (13:1+).

tokens.name: flare
tokens.usage: Live and urgent: a session in progress, a deadline today, a streak at risk. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: on-flare
tokens.usage: Text on `flare` fills (5.2:1 light, 7.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status text and icons on `surface`/`surface-raised` (5.5:1+). Always with a word or icon — it shares lightness with `danger`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution status text and icons on `surface`/`surface-raised`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, text and icons on `surface`/`surface-raised` (5.9:1+). Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational status and coach tips, text on `surface`/`surface-raised`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. ≥5.8:1 on all surfaces.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per screen at most: onboarding, match-day hero, milestone unlocked.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page titles on marketing and program overview screens.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, sheet titles, section heads.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Keep your hips open so the next pass is already in your head.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Three sets of eight, alternating feet. Rest 45 seconds between sets.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Supporting text, card metadata, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels, badges, tab labels, eyebrow text.

styles.name: stat-xl
styles.usage: The one hero number in a StatTile (top speed, minutes, rating).

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Secondary numbers, table totals, player ratings.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Splits, deltas, tabular figures inside tables.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Most layouts only need space-2, space-4 and space-6.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control; between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (small), list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; page gutter; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on tablet+; space between groups in a form.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hero padding; the stripe width of the mown-pitch pattern.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of page breathing room on large screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, progress bars, inputs' inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Avatars, toggle tracks, the live dot. Not buttons.

shadow.note: Breakaway is flat first: borders and fills do the work. Shadows only for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Pressed-out cards on `surface` when a border is not enough.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Sheets, menus, toasts — anything floating above the page.
